title: What Can I Sell on Etsy?
supports: Opened with WebFetch (no date shown). Everything listed must be made, designed, handpicked or sourced by the seller; the four Creativity Standards categories with examples; AI tools allowed with the seller's own creative input, AI use disclosed in the listing description; no bot-generated content, AI-generated functional instructions or AI prompt bundles; production partners must be disclosed. etsy.com/legal/creativity returned 403.

title: Working with Production Partners on Etsy
supports: Opened with WebFetch. A production partner makes items from the seller's own designs; disclose on listings and in the About section; set under Settings, Partners you work with, or in the listing; print-on-demand services are a valid partner type; suppliers, white label, OEM and ODM manufacturers and wholesalers are not partners, and using them to source items for resale breaks the reselling policy.

title: Does Etsy Allow Drop Shipping or Reselling?
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Drop shipping is not allowed except craft and party supplies; reselling is not allowed except craft and party supplies, vintage items over 20 years old, and gift baskets the seller selects and packs; adding a card to an unaltered bought-in item is not allowed.

title: How to Create a Listing
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Up to 20 photos and 2 videos of 5 to 15 seconds; titles up to 140 characters, fewer than 15 words suggested, say what the item is, avoid repetition, subjective words, price and shipping; 13 tags; attributes depend on category; custom variations are not filterable; processing and shipping profiles; GPSR manufacturer and safety fields for traders selling to the EEA or Northern Ireland; How it's made (who, what, when) and production partners; sections, featured listings, renewal.

title: How to Use Tags to Get Found in Search
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Up to 13 tags per listing, each up to 20 characters, letters, numbers and spaces; tags can be phrases; tags are most useful where no matching attribute exists; buyer-focused phrases such as gift for her; use a varied set.

title: How to Use Attributes When Listing an Item
supports: Opened with WebFetch. The category sets which attributes are available; attributes help buyers find items; fill in both attributes and tags; choose the closest colour and add the exact shade as a tag; materials and material features (plastic-free, reusable, upcycled, vegan) with criteria.

title: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) for Shop and Listing Pages
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Titles under 15 words with key traits first, since search engines show about the first 50 to 60 characters; the listing web address is set at first publish; the description's first sentence says what the item is, without repeating phrases; alt text on photos; no bought links; no one can guarantee top placement.

title: How to Use the Etsy Search Visibility Page
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Checks for priority placement: at least one image; primary photo 2000 pixels or more, a single image of the finished product, clear and well lit; specific category; a return policy (even no returns); US listings with domestic shipping under $6 prioritised; complete shop with logo; customer service standards affect visibility; title recommendation tool; changes can take up to a day.

title: How Do I Use Etsy's Marketplace Insights Tool?
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Shows popular and related search terms, searches and listings counts and trends for the last 30 days; Shop Manager, Stats, Marketplace Insights, web only; 15 keyword searches a week on the free tier, unlimited with Etsy Plus.

title: How to Use Etsy Stats for Your Shop
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Visits, orders, average order value, conversion rate and revenue; traffic sources including Etsy search, Etsy Ads and offsite ads; search terms that brought shoppers; listing views, favourites, orders and revenue; no export described.

title: What to Do If You Notice a Drop in Sales
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Compare year over year; search results are personalised, so searching for your own items is not a reliable rank check; replace keywords that bring no traffic; fix flagged listing quality issues (dark or blurry main photo, collage, vague category, missing return policy, high US shipping price).

title: Requirements and Best Practices for Images in Your Etsy Shop
supports: Opened with WebFetch. At least 2000 pixels each side recommended, first photo at least 635 pixels, horizontal or square; at least one unedited photo of the actual item on a real background; functional guides need a photo of a real result; AI and other edits allowed for light, colour, cropping and backgrounds but not to hide flaws; note AI edits in the description.

title: How Ads Are Placed in Etsy Search
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Ads compete in an auction on listing quality (likelihood of a click, listing and shop history, titles and tags) and bid; relevance comes from titles and tags; filters such as ship-to country apply; pay per click; you may not see your own ads.

title: How to Set Up and Manage an Etsy Ads Campaign
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Daily budget with a minimum and a starting maximum that Etsy recalculates weekly; spend never exceeds the daily budget; strategies Greater visibility, Efficient spending, Lower click cost; all listings advertised by default; a waiting period after opening a shop; pay per click; turn off listings or the whole campaign.

title: How to Review the Performance of Your Etsy Ads
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Metrics: views, clicks, click rate, orders, revenue, spend, ROAS; orders count if the shopper buys within 30 days of clicking; run an ad for 30 days before turning it off; use ROAS to choose listings.

title: How Etsy's Offsite Ads Work
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Etsy chooses listings to advertise off Etsy; fee only on attributed orders within 30 days of a click; 15% fee for shops under $10,000 in any 365 days, 12% at or above; mandatory for the life of the shop once $10,000 is reached; fee capped at $100 per order; only shops never over the threshold can opt out.

title: How to Set Up Shipping Information
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Shipping profiles hold rates, processing time, service, origin and destinations; one profile per listing, and editing a profile changes every listing on it; fixed or calculated shipping (calculated only for US and Canada sellers with USPS or Canada Post); Everywhere Else means worldwide; US-bound orders must include duties and import fees upfront to keep Purchase Protection (from July 9; year not stated on the page).

title: How to Set Processing Times, Processing Profiles and Ship By Dates
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Processing time sets the ship-by date and when buyers can open a case or review; processing profiles (made to order or ready to ship); shorter times can shorten delivery estimates; actual times shown if faster (past 120 days, at least 5 orders); ship-by date can be extended once by up to 21 days.

title: What are Etsy's Customer Service Standards?
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Minimums: reply to 80% of first messages within 48 hours; ship 80% of orders on time; limits on reviews of 3 stars or lower; limits on refunded cases; missing standards can lower search visibility and Purchase Protection eligibility; Etsy may remove reviews only about things outside the seller's control.

title: What is the Star Seller Badge?
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Reply to 95% of first messages within 24 hours; 95% of orders on time with tracking; average rating 4.8 or higher; at least 5 orders and $300 in sales over the past 3 months; eligible 90 days after first sale; reviewed on the 1st of each month.

title: How the Review System Works for Sellers
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Buyers have 100 days from delivery to review; the shop rating is weighted to recent reviews (the past 12 months count most, weight halves each year); reviews can be downloaded as JSON; removed reviews cannot be reinstated.

title: What to Do if You Receive a Negative Review
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Message the buyer first; one public response per review within 100 days of the buyer's last edit; a response stops the buyer editing; no tracking numbers, links or private information; Etsy removes only reviews that break its policies.

title: What is the General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR)?
supports: Opened with WebFetch. GPSR may apply to traders selling into the EEA and Northern Ireland wherever they are based; add an economic operator and/or manufacturer details and the Product safety info field; option to stop selling to GPSR countries; Etsy cannot decide trader status and suggests legal advice.

title: Shared Access for Etsy Shop Owners
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Owners invite up to 5 team members with their own accounts and two-factor sign-in; members can manage orders, create, edit and publish listings, and reply to messages; they cannot cancel or refund orders, delete or deactivate listings, see finances, or open marketing, stats, settings or apps; the owner stays responsible.

title: Etsy Open API v3 documentation
supports: Opened with WebFetch. OAuth-based API for listings, orders and shop management; Seller App access covers the seller's own shop only with no commercial use; screen-scraping is not allowed; the OpenAPI Dev MCP server gives AI coding assistants API documentation and schemas, not shop data.

title: How to Comply with US CPSC eFiling Requirements
supports: Opened with WebFetch. From July 8, 2026 importers of products under CPSC rules must file certificate data electronically before entry; children's products usually need a Children's Product Certificate; postal imports must use the CPSC Product Registry route; missing data can delay or stop shipments.

title: EU Regulation 2023/988 on General Product Safety: detailed guidance (Northern Ireland)
publisher: Office for Product Safety and Standards, GOV.UK
supports: Opened with WebFetch (updated 4 November 2025). GPSR applies from 13 December 2024; a responsible economic operator established in the EU or Northern Ireland is needed; its details and the manufacturer's on the product, packaging, parcel or an accompanying document; type, batch or serial number; safety information in language consumers understand; technical documentation kept 10 years.

title: General Product Safety Regulations 2005: Great Britain
publisher: Office for Product Safety and Standards, GOV.UK
supports: Opened with WebFetch (updated 13 December 2024). Products must be safe in normal or foreseeable use; producers give risk information, mark the producer's name and address and a batch reference where reasonable, keep a complaints register and notify Trading Standards of unsafe products; distributors must not supply products they know or should know are dangerous.

title: CE marking
supports: Opened with WebFetch (last checked 17/07/2026). CE marking is needed only for products covered by EU rules that require it, such as toys, electrical and electronic equipment, batteries and personal protective equipment; the manufacturer, including anyone selling under their own name, affixes it; others fall under general product safety rules.

title: Small Batch Manufacturers and Crafters
supports: Opened with WebFetch. Small batch makers must register each year to get relief from third-party testing for some children's product rules only; small parts, lead in paint, durable infant products and other Group A rules always need an accepted lab; a Children's Product Certificate and tracking labels are always required; relief is not an exemption from the rules.
